name: score_relevance
description: Given a product description and a regulatory obligation, score how directly the obligation applies to the product. Call this tool exactly once with the relevance score and reason.

relevance_score.description: How directly the obligation applies to the product (0.0 = entirely unrelated, 1.0 = directly governs this product). Obligations that could plausibly apply score at least 0.4.

relevance_reason.description: A concise explanation of why this score was assigned, referencing the product and obligation.
